problems: The guess ('small boat or canoe hull, pointed at the right, zigzag at the blunt left end') partly fits: the body is elongated and tapers to the right, but the left end reads as a boat's blunt stern rather than a forked shuttle end. The title and the thread-and-hook stars are not reflected in the silhouette at all.
The shuttle body is squashed: roughly 150 px long and only about 20 px tall (y ~317 to ~351), so it reads as a thin line rather than a shuttle with a belly.
The two prong stars are crowded: 76243 at about (86,330) and 76219 at about (88,348) sit only about 18 px apart, so the fork does not read as a fork.
The belly star 74785 at about (167,332) is barely separated from the lower edge 75379 at about (134,351). The thickest point of the body is not visible.

The labels overlap badly. 'upper prong tip of the forked...', 'belly of the shuttle, where...' and 'lower edge of the shuttle bo...' stack on the same lines around y 315-340, and they are unreadable. Several labels are also truncated ('the loop where the thread tu', 'the hook-ring the thread is').

The thread path is sparse. The loop 73165 at about (257,240), the upper mending end 72631 at about (286,202) and the hook-ring 71957 at about (321,264) form a thin gold chain. That chain is a reasonable thread line, but it is detached from the shuttle and reads as a separate sketch.

The figure is the right way up (fork at left, taper at right, thread rising from the far end). The gold lines sit on the stars and are not a copy of a silhouette, but the blue outline is a loose hull-like shape rather than a drawn shuttle silhouette.

Several unrelated stars sit near the figure, at about (230,120), (307,123), (391,201), (432,202), (448,272), (429,409), (84,436), (285,456) and (214,460). They are not part of the shuttle, and the open field around the figure makes it look sparse.
output.advice:
Redraw so the shuttle reads as a tapered, thick-bellied boat with a forked end, and keep the thread as a clear extension.

1. Shuttle body: make it about 2.5 to 3 times taller. Place the belly star 74785 near (167,325) as the widest point. Put the lower edge 75379 about 30 px below the belly, near (140,355), so the underside curves. Keep the far tapered end 73473 at about (239,317), so the body tapers from belly to tip.
2. Fork: spread the prongs. Put the upper prong 76243 near (84,318) and the lower prong 76219 near (84,352), so the fork opens to about 35 px. Draw the fork as a V joining the body at the blunt left end.
3. Thread: keep 73473 → 73165 (257,240) → 72631 (286,202) as the rising thread line, and 73165 → 71957 hook-ring (321,264) as the hung branch. These already sit correctly and should stay.
4. Labels: put the text outside the figure, in the empty top-left or bottom area, with leader lines. Shorten them to fit, for example 'prong tips', 'belly', 'lower edge', 'thread end', 'hook-ring', and avoid stacking any two labels at the same y.
5. Gold lines: draw a clean outline from the prong tips around the belly to the tapered end, then the thread chain. Do not connect the unrelated background stars.
6. Consider dropping or dimming the background stars near the figure so the shuttle silhouette stands out."
